speech.heard: In the USA, 64.1% of government expenses go to subsidies and transfers, in Saudi Arabia, 11.3%. The USA spends 5.7 times what Saudi Arabia spends on subsidies and transfers. Czech Republic is the world's highest, spending 83.9% of expenses on transfers. Germany joins them near the top, at 80.1%. Worldwide, the median country spends 38.5%. Near the bottom, Dr. Congo dedicates 10.7%. How much of your budget goes to subsidies and transfers?
